intro: Over the past month, ZCyberNews has tracked 24 articles under the Windows tag, with the threat actors Kyber, Chaotic Eclipse, and VECT Ransomware among the most frequently observed. The coverage spans from April 12 to May 9, 2026, and highlights five key vulnerabilities: CVE-2024-1708 (CVSS 8.4), CVE-2026-33104 (CVSS 7.8), CVE-2026-8069 (CVSS 7.8), CVE-2026-26179 (CVSS 7.5), and CVE-2026-32183 (CVSS 7.5). The affected sectors include consumer electronics, gaming, government, IT, and managed service providers, with North America as the primary region. The severity mix comprises 18 high, 2 critical, and 4 medium-severity incidents.
